notes: Inbound from mobile multiplayer social game - small studio (14 engs). Found us via blog post on low-latency streaming. Wants self-serve hosted API to avoid infra ops. Key asks: streaming token-level latency, integrated moderation tools, per-user rate limiting and spam controls. Currently using Firebase auth + Firestore for chat state. Team wants to keep message history retention short (~7 days) and avoid sending PII to third parties. Quote from PM: "need chat to feel instant in lobby — sub-200ms feels right; also must auto-moderate toxic content at scale." Pricing sensitivity - will start slow (50k messages/month) then ramp if cost/Ops OK. Interested in sample prompts + turnkey moderation rules. Agrees SOC2 is nice but not a blocker now; wants audit logs and SSO for devops console. Prefers hosted to start; will consider Dedicated only if costs exceed projections. Quick wins: provide test API key, moderation policy examples, and a small latency benchmark from us to their US-east users.
